text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired (INC-2026-0001) - surge of 429s on prod /v1/generate. Auto-escalation enabled. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-0001

pagerduty-bot: Page sent to @Alex P (primary oncall) — escalation in 3m if unacked.

Alex P: acked — I'm on it. beginning triage, pulling dashboards + logs.

Priya G: looking at metrics now, 429s spiked ~5m ago across us-east/us-west. rate-limiter (limiter-svc) shows many downstream "quota-mapper returned DENY" errors.

Samir R: seeing same. limiter pods show restart churn on limiter-0. kubectl shows OOMKilled on limiter-0 around 1749900900. possible memory regression from last deploy.

Alex P: what's customer impact? any major tenants blocked?

Priya G: quick filter by tenant_id -> top affected: tenant=acme-corp (high rps). ~25% of their requests got 429 in past 6m. also a noisy synthetic fanout.

Tess L: Acme support pinged us, ticket INC-ACME-789. they're seeing user-facing errors. I'll keep them updated.

Samir R: propose temporary mitigation: enable fail-open fallback in routing so requests bypass quota-mapper if mapper returns empty/malformed. I can flip a feature flag for 5m. risk: brief permissive window.

Alex P: do it. annotate all changes. set 2-minute watch.

Samir R: running command now:
```bash
redwood-admin feature-toggle set fail_open_on_mapper_error true --env=prod --reason="auto-mitigate INC-2026-0001"
```

Samir R: toggle applied, rolling to edge routers. status: 20% -> 100% in 45s.

Priya G: metrics: 429 rate dropped from 2100/min -> 150/min within 90s. Acme trace correlation shows successful responses now returning 200s.

incident-bot: Auto-suppression attempted for noisy PD alerts; suppression disabled by policy since customer impact > 5% traffic.

pagerduty-bot: Notifying secondary oncall in 2m for confirmation.

Alex P: good mitigation. next: root cause. Priya — can you check recent deploys to quota-mapper?

Priya G: checking deploy history — quota-mapper v2.14 rolled at 1749899400 (20m before spike). Config patch #4567 added stricter handling for missing token metadata; fallback path now returns DENY instead of FAIL_OPEN when redis key lookup miss occurs.

Priya G: logs from mapper:
```
2026-03-15T23:41:02Z WARN tenant-lookup: missing metadata for token=xxxx, returning DENY
2026-03-15T23:41:02Z ERROR redis: GET tenant:xxxx -> nil (TTL mismatch)
```

Samir R: that aligns. the deploy changed behavior and combined with redis TTL rotation -> default-deny blast radius. revert or patch?

Alex P: revert to previous mapper behavior (fail-open) until we have canary + safety checks. Samir, can you revert config or roll back?

Samir R: initiating rollback now (config revert, keep feature-flag as additional safety). command:
```bash
kubectl set image deployment/quota-mapper quota-mapper=quota-mapper:v2.13 --namespace=prod
```

Samir R: rollout started, pods terminating and coming back up.

Priya G: limiter pod restarts also look related to memory growth in the new mapper client lib. will open a memory profiling ticket.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-0001 acknowledged by Alex P. escalation paused.

Tess L: Acme updated — their traffic looks stable and errors have dropped to baseline. Thanks team.

Alex P: monitoring for 30m post-mitigation. 429s now stable ~50/min (normal). marking incident status: mitigated.

Priya G: preliminary RCA: config change in quota-mapper returned DENY on lookup miss combined with redis TTL rotation + heavier traffic from synthetic fanout. Contributing: lack of canary and missing alert for mapper returning >=1% DENY on token-lookup.

Samir R: follow-ups I'm owning:
- add canary gate for quota-mapper deploys
- instrument mapper to emit "lookup_miss_rate" metric and alert if >0.5%
- add memory regression test and limit to container resources

Alex P: I'll keep PD incident open until postmortem is posted. once PRs are merged and monitoring in place we can resolve.

Priya G: creating postmortem doc and linking action items. will assign owners + ETA.

Tess L: I'll send customer post-incident note to Acme with status + mitigation summary.

Alex P: resolved (mitigated) at 1749901300 — leaving thread open for action items. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Priya G: noted. closing follow-ups in 72h after PRs land.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-0001 status changed to RESOLVED (mitigated).

incident-bot: Please add runbook update: when quota-mapper returns more than 0.5% DENY on token-lookup, automatically trigger fail-open and page oncall.

Alex P: added to runbook draft.

Tess L: thanks team — prepare customer timeline for the support ticket.

Priya G: small log note: stack traces pointed to mapper client v1.4.3; pin reverted to v1.4.1. PR opened: https://git.example/r/redwood/quota-mapper/pulls/4590

Samir R: will follow up with canary rollout steps in PR.

Alex P: thanks everyone. I'll file final postmortem by EOD.

Priya G: :white_check_mark:

Tess L: :raised_hands:
